tools.name: check_shariah_compliance
tools.description: Check if a cryptocurrency is Halal or Haram under AAOIFI Shariah standards (No. 59 and No. 21). Returns compliance status, scholarly justification, category, and audit link.

ticker_or_name.description: The cryptocurrency symbol or name (e.g. BTC, Bitcoin, KAS, SOL, AAVE)

tools.name: get_halal_index_summary
tools.description: Get institutional statistics and methodology summary for the Halal Crypto Index (820 audited assets, AAOIFI standard, CERN Zenodo DOI).

tools.name: list_halal_coins
tools.description: List verified Halal cryptocurrencies filtered by optional category.

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. Layer 1, Store of Value)
